title: Residential Natural Gas Supply — Rebill Credit on the Most Recent Energy Line
content:
## Lines settled

This policy settles the energy line of the most recent bill on a Residential Natural Gas Supply agreement — the energy line whose billing period starts latest — when that line was billed above the rate the plan allows for its cycle.

It applies only when all of the following hold:

- that line's cycle began on or after the agreement's most recent plan change date, or its service start date when it has none, so that the plan in force today is the plan the line was billed under;
- the most recent variable rate change notice on the agreement took effect on or before that cycle's billing period start and was issued at least the plan's variable rate notice period, in calendar days, before its effective date;
- no regulatory pass-through notice stands on the agreement; and
- on a month-to-month variable plan, the cycle is past the plan's introductory cycles and is not a cycle held at the expiring rate after a late-notice rollover.

A line outside that scope keeps the allowed rate the gas supply billing, variable rate, rollover and regulatory pass-through rules give it, and is corrected under the base gas billing correction rule, without the supplements of this policy.

## Posting and authority

The latest-bill rebill credit is posted as one negative rebill credit tied to the disputed line, on the bill of that line's billing cycle.

The over-billed amount before any supplement is what is compared with the agent adjustment limit; when it is above that limit the correction is opened as a gas billing dispute for review instead of being posted.

## Recording the credit

**Capability.** `post_gas_rebill_credit_0e7c2434` posts a rebill credit that returns money on one over-billed residential gas bill line. One call adds one new credit line to the agreement's bill ledger, tied to the original line it corrects, dated today and shown on the bill of the corrected line's billing cycle; the credit is stored as a negative amount equal to the value given. The original line is left as it was. Afterwards the credit appears in the agreement's bill lines with the corrected line's reference.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `post_gas_rebill_credit_0e7c2434` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `gas_agreement_id` | the residential natural gas agreement number the corrected line belongs to, as returned by the gas agreement lookup | agreement number |
| `source_billing_id` | the reference number of the original gas bill line being corrected, as returned by the gas bill line lookup | bill line reference |
| `billing_period_start` | the first day of the billing cycle of the corrected line, exactly as shown on that line | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `credit_amount_usd` | the credit to return, in US dollars, given as a positive amount; it is posted as the matching negative amount | 2 decimal places; rounded half to even at the third place if more places are given |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence giving the new credit line's reference number, the corrected line's reference, the billing cycle start (YYYY-MM-DD), the amount credited in US dollars to 2 decimal places and the posting date (today, YYYY-MM-DD). Receiving it means the rebill credit is on the ledger.
